headline: CVS Health Plans to Separate Pharmacy Business and Disassemble Conglomerate
summary: CVS Health plans to separate its pharmacy business to dismantle its healthcare conglomerate, with CVS Pharmacy housing about 9,000 retail drugstores, in-store clinics, and fulfillment warehouses.
why: CVS Health is a major US healthcare and retail pharmacy conglomerate. Corporate breakups of this scale can unlock hidden shareholder value or streamline operations, drawing close attention from institutional investors.

impacts.name: CVS Health
impacts.why: The company is executing a major corporate restructuring by separating its pharmacy business.
